# uptimeeye Provider

Manage UptimeEye monitors, scheduled tasks, notification channels, status pages and variables declaratively.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "uptimeeye" {
  # Create the key in the UptimeEye app under Settings → API Keys.
  # Can also be provided via the UPTIMEEYE_API_KEY environment variable.
  api_key = var.uptimeeye_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Organization API key (`ue_live_...`), created in the UptimeEye app under Settings → API Keys. Can also be set via the `UPTIMEEYE_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) UptimeEye management API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.uptimeeye.com`. Can also be set via the `UPTIMEEYE_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
